faqs.question: Which MacBook models do you have batteries for?
faqs.answer: MacBook Pro 16-inch (A2485/2021 and A2141/2019) and MacBook Air 13-inch (A2669/M2/2022 and A2337/M1/2020). Check the model number on the bottom of your MacBook and message us on WhatsApp to confirm before ordering.

faqs.question: How much does each one cost?
How do I find my MacBook's model number?
faqs.answer: It's printed on the bottom case of your MacBook, usually starting with 'Model: A' followed by 4 digits. Send us a photo on WhatsApp if you're not sure which one you have.

faqs.question: What warranty comes with a MacBook battery?
faqs.answer: Every battery here comes with a warranty — message us on WhatsApp for the current term before ordering.
